Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from us for this game and the ODI series. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. Cricket does not stop though, we will have the Champions Trophy starting from June 1. Do join us for all the action from that tournament. Post that, these two sides will again lock horns in the shortest format of the game on June 21, 2017. We look forward to your company for all the games. Until then, it's goodbye and take care!

Man of the Series and England skipper, Eoin Morgan says that they lost the game in the first hour. Credits South Africa for making the most of the conditions. Calls it just a hiccup after the good work done before. Accepts that they need to mix caution with aggression going ahead and not play too many aggressive shots. Feels that they can make up for the dot balls later so they need to be patient in tough conditions. Calls it a bad day. Admits that they wanted to give players enough rest going into the mega event. Further mentions that Jason Roy has scored a lot of runs before and they back him to come good. Credits Ben Stokes for playing well as it was an important series for a few of them. Hopes to take the positives into the Champions Trophy. Calls it flattering to be considered favorites but hopes that they don't get carried away and promises that they will give it a good crack.

South Africa skipper, AB de Villiers says the team had a lot to play for today and he feels good after a win against a quality side at Lord's. Feels that the catching was good but the fielding was a little sluggish. Credits his bowlers for their good show. Says that they hit the right lengths. Reckons that they have 15 good players in the squad and it is hard to choose the best XI from them for the Champions Trophy. Also says that they are quite confident heading into the tournament.

Man of the Match, Kagiso Rabada says that there was something for the bowlers and all of them capitalized on it. He adds that he tries to improve every game he plays. Mentions that there was good bounce in the wicket, especially with the new ball. Ends by saying that the team is looking forward to the Champions Trophy.

England never looked like they were in the game. They did have their moments in the middle when Jake Ball and Toby Roland-Jones bowled some tight overs and picked up three quick wickets. The tourists though were always in the driving seat and emerged victorious. They avoid a whitewash and this victory will give them confidence going into the Champions Trophy. Earlier, it was only due to Jonny Bairstow's fifty that they had the total to bowl at. Kagiso Rabada was the star for the tourists with a 4-fer.

South Africa have cruised to victory! They were always on top after the good work earlier on. Amla and de Kock provided an excellent start with a 95-run opening stand. Amla scored a fluent 55 with some beautiful cricketing shots. They did lose 3 quick wickets in the middle, but Duminy and de Villiers did not panic and made sure they won the game without any fuss. This is the first time in 4 attempts that they have won an ODI at Lord's and they will be happy with that.

FOUR! That's the game for South Africa! Duminy finishes it off with a beautiful cover drive. Full ball outside off stump, Duminy leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary. SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 7 WICKETS!
Full ball outside off, Duminy drives it straight to mid off.
Length ball outside off, Duminy tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full on off stump, de Villiers drives it to long off for a run.
50-run stand up between de Villiers and Duminy.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Short and wide outside off, de Villiers cuts it through the vacant point region for a boundary. An important partnership between the two. Only three needed now.
Back of a length ball, Duminy plays it to the point region.
Length on middle, de Villiers flicks it on the leg side for a run.
BEATEN! Length ball on off stump, moves away off the wicket. De Villiers pokes at it and gets beaten.
Bowls it on the pads, Duminy flicks it down to fine leg for a run.
Length ball outside off, Duminy guides it down to third man for a couple.
Length ball, de Villiers tries to defend it but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls to the leg side. They complete a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, de Villiers slashes it uppishly through backward point for another boundary.
FOUR! INNOVATION! Bowls it full on middle and leg, de Villiers goes down on one knee and paddle sweeps it to the fine leg boundary.
Slight drizzle again, been that kind of a day.
Length ball, angling away, de Villiers guides it into the hands of gully.
Uses his feet, takes the ball on the full and hits it straight to mid off.
Bowls it on the pads, Duminy tickles it down to fine leg for a run.
David Willey comes back on.
FOUR! De Villiers comes down the track and smashes it past mid on for a boundary. Two boundaries in the over. A good over for South Africa.
Full ball on the stumps, Duminy drives it past the bowler to the left of mid off for a single.
FOUR! Short outside off, Duminy guides it beautifully through the vacant third man area for a boundary.
Half appeal for a catch! Short of a length ball, Duminy goes for the pull but misses it. The ball hits his pads and lobs up to gully who catches it. They all appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Back of a length ball, Duminy defends it off the back foot.
Full outside off, Duminy drives it through cover-point, the batsmen run two.
Length on middle, de Villiers tucks it behind square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Full ball outside off, de Villiers leans into the drive, gets it through the vacant cover region and the ball races away to the fence.
Defends the length ball on off, off the back foot.
Back of a length on middle, the batsman works it to mid-wicket.
Length ball on middle, de Villiers defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length ball, de Villiers defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length ball, Duminy defends it off the back foot.
Length ball outside off stump, Duminy lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Full on off stump, Duminy drives it to mid off.
Full outside off, Duminy goes for the drive but bottom edges it back to the bowler.
Full ball angling in, Duminy plays it through the vacant mid-wicket region for a couple.
A run after 15 balls! Length ball on off, de Villiers plays it with soft hands towards covers and they run through for a single. De Villiers is now off the mark, after 12 dot balls.
Lands it on a length, on the stumps, Duminy covers the line and defends it off the front foot. Another maiden over.
Defends the length ball on off stump on the front foot.
BEATEN! Lovely stuff, length ball angles away from the batsman, Duminy looks to defend it off the back foot but gets beaten.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Lands it on a length, the batsman covers the line and defends it off the back foot.
Back of a length ball, Duminy defends it off the back foot.
Bowls it outside off, the batsman lets it go through to the keeper.
Length ball wide outside off, de Villiers goes for the cut but is beaten.
Short ball on the stumps, de Villiers goes for the pull, but is beaten by the inward movement and mistimes it back down the wicket.
Short ball which is rising on the batsman, de Villiers looks to ride the bounce and punch but mistimes it back down the wicket.
Brave leave there! Bowls it on a length, comes back in after pitching, de Villiers is happy to leave it. The ball just goes over the off stump.
The batsman lets the length ball outside off go through to the keeper.
Steven Finn returns for a bowl.
BEATEN! Good bowling from Roland-Jones. Bowls it on a length, angles it away from the batsman, Duminy pokes at it but is beaten.
Lands it on a length, angling away, Duminy tries to defend it off the back foot but gets an outside edge which just falls short of fourth slip.
Length ball outside off stump, Duminy punches it to covers.
Back of a length on off stump, Duminy goes to push it off the back foot but gets an inside edge, the ball rolls through mid-wicket. A couple taken.
Length ball, angling away from the batsman, Duminy lets it go through to the keeper.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT!  Length ball, Duminy rocks back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through. Ball has bowled out here, he has good figures today - 10-0-43-2!
Persists with his line outside off, de Villiers lets the ball go through.
The batsman leaves the length ball outside off.
Length delivery outside off, de Villiers lets it go through.
Lands it on a length, the ball jags in, de Villiers looks to defend but is beaten all ends up. There is half an appeal from England but is given not out.
Bowls on the pads, Duminy flicks it down to mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE! Strays it down the leg side, Duminy lets the ball go, it's called a wide.
Angles in a full ball on the stumps, de Villiers defends it watchfully towards gully.
The rain seems to have vanished. Thankfully.
Length ball around off, Duminy looks to defend it off the front foot but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls to fine leg for a single.
Lands it on a length outside off, Duminy lets it go through to the keeper.
Pushes the length delivery through the covers for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Duminy lets it go through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball, Duminy defends it off the back foot.
AB de Villiers is the new man in. He's come with some rain. South Africa will want to ensure 20 overs are completed before they go off to ensure a result.

OUT! Ball has his man! He was troubling Faf du Plessis and now has dismissed him. Hurls it on a fuller length outside off, du Plessis throws his bat at it and gets an outside edge which is snapped up by Buttler behind the wickets. He never looked comfortable and now has to depart. Ball is making a mark here. South Africa need 53 more runs.
Bowled down the leg side, Duminy flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Back of a length ball, Duminy plays it to the point region.
Drifts on the pads, Faf flicks it through the leg side for a run.

Big appeal for caught behind! Ball bowls it on a length, angles it in and then it moves away off the surface, du Plessis pokes at it but gets beaten. There is a sound as the ball passes the bat and the players appeal. The umpire gives it not out. Replays show the sound was of the bat hitting the pad.
Leaves the length ball outside the off stump.
Hits a length outside off, Duminy lets it go through to the keeper. Maiden over by Roland-Jones.
Duminy drives the full ball to mid off.
Length ball angling away, Duminy goes for the pull but does not connect and it goes through to the keeper.
Full ball on off stump, Duminy drives it down the ground. Finn dives to his left from mid off and stops the ball.
Back of a length ball, Duminy defends it off the back foot.
Duminy leaves the length ball outside off stump.
Back of a length ball, Faf defends it off the back foot.
Lands on a length outside off, Faf du Plessis lets the ball go through.
A gully in place now.
FOUR! EDGED! Length ball outside off, Faf slashes at it and gets a thick outside edge which flies past second slip for a boundary. He gets off the mark with a boundary.
Faf du Plessis walks out to bat. Three slips in place for him.
OUT! BOWLED'EM! Ball bowls a yorker on off, de Kock can't get his bat down in time and gets his stumps shattered. Two wickets in two overs. Can England build on the pressure?
BEATEN! Full and wide outside off, de Kock slashes at it but does not get bat to it.
Back of a length on the stumps, de Kock guides it to the point region.
No Faf, JP Duminy is the new man in. South Africa aiming to give him some batting practice before the Champions Trophy.

OUT! Maiden ODI wicket for Roland-Jones. Bowls it on a shortish length outside off, Amla goes for the pull but gets an inside edge which goes onto hit the stumps. Not a bad wicket to start your international career. England get their first breakthrough. A good knock there by Amla.
FOUR! LOVELY TIMING! Full on off stump, Amla just times the drive through covers for another boundary. The boundaries are leaking here.
Short ball outside off, de Kock cuts it down to third man for a run.
Full on off stump, de Kock pushes it down the ground and they run through for two.
Back of a length ball on off stump, de Kock pushes it to the off side.
FOUR! Gift and put away. Full toss on off stump, de Kock leans forward and drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Length ball, Amla defends it off the front foot.
WIDE! Bowls it way outside off stump and the umpire signals a wide.
33rd ODI fifty for Hashim Amla.
FOUR! LUCKY! Length ball on the stumps, Amla goes for the punch but gets an inside edge and it races to the fine leg fence. The boundary also brings up his fifty. He has made light work of the chase.
Lands on a length outside off, Amla shoulders his arms to it.
Length ball outside off, Amla lets it go through to the keeper.
FOUR! Short on the leg stump, Amla gets inside the line to pull but gloves it down to the fine leg fence.
Short ball on middle stump, Amla defends it off the back foot.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Drifts on the pads, de Kock flicks it through the leg side for a couple.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, de Kock leans forward and drives it between covers and mid off for a boundary.
Bowls it around off, Amla hops and flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length ball, de Kock plays it to the point region for a run.
Length ball outside off, the batsman looks to force it through the off side but fails to connect.
Toby Roland-Jones called on.
BEATEN! Lovely stuff from Ball, he pitches this one on a length, on off stump, moves away off the deck, Amla pokes at it but gets beaten.
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Full ball on off stump, Amla leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Fuller length outside off, Amla gets squared up and gets a leading edge and the ball lands on the off side.
Length ball on off stump, Amla drives it on the up thorugh cover-point for a couple.
Drifts on the pads of the batsman, Amla flicks it to square leg for a couple.
Bowls it on a length outside off, Amla lets the ball go through to the keeper.

Welcome back for the remainder of the game. How long will South Africa take? Can England strike early and trigger a collapse? Let's see. Hashim Amla and Quinton de Kock are back out to bat, Jake Ball to bowl.
...Post lunch session...

Good reply from South Africa! They have started well, adding 59 runs for the opening wicket. The hosts did not quite have the intent to defend the low score. The Proteas need 95 more runs in the next 39 overs. Scoring the remaining runs should not be much of a problem for the visitors. Can England strike after the break and trigger a collapse? Or will the tourists run away with the game? Join us for the remainder of the chase in a while.
Good length on off, de Kock comes forward and pushes it to covers. That is it, the players are going off for the break. South Africa need 95 from 234 balls.
Slants it on a length on off, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Angles it on a fuller length on off, Amla gets across and defends it.
Too full on the pads, de Kock clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Slants it outside off, de Kock comes forward and pushes it to covers.
Fuller in length on off, de Kock drives it back down the wicket. Finn gets a hand to it and parries it towards mid off. No run taken.
Powerplay 2 signaled. Four fielders are now allowed the 30-yard circle for the next 30 overs.
Lands it outside off, left alone.
Shorter outside off, Amla punches it towards point.
Beaten! Hurls it outside off on a back of a length, Amla shuffles away a long way. The ball moves away late and beats him all ends up.
Hurls it outside off on a length, Amla lets it go through.
On a length on off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller in length on off, de Kock times his push towards mid on.
Amla turns this one towards mid-wicket from his crease.
Angles it on a good length, Amla gets across and tucks it towards the leg side.
FOUR! Gorgeous! Fuller length outside off, Amla stands his crease and just drives it through extra cover for a majestic boundary. They are doing this with ease.
Fuller length outside off, Amla comes forward and defends it.
FOUR! Top shot! Good length outside off, Amla rides the bounce and punches it on the up through covers. Bairstow looks to cut it off in the deep but comes second best. 50 up for South Africa.
Hurls it outside off on a good length, Amla looks to defend but is beaten all ends up.
On a length, on the stumps, de Kock is beaten by the inward movement but gets it towards fine leg for a brace.
Fuller and angling into the pads, de Kock clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, Amla flays it through point for a single. It went off the outside edge.
Short ball on the stumps, de Kock plays a terrific pull to deep square leg for a single.
First signs of what England did! A flashy drive! Outside off on a length, de Kock throw his kitchen sink at it. Fails to make any connection.
Shorter outside off, de Kock looks to punch but gets it off the inside half back down the wicket.
Back of a length outside off, Amla punches it on the up towards covers.
Turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls it too full on off, de Kock digs it out watchfully.
Amla punches this on the up towards point for a single.
Stands tall and defends it watchfully.

FOUR! What a hit! Short ball from Finn outside off, Amla gets on top of it and pulls it through square leg for a boundary. He beats Virat Kohli to become the fastest batsman to 7,000 ODI runs, in 11 less innings.
Steven Finn called on for a bowl.
Good length just around off, de Kock looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. He wants a run but is sent back.
Outside off on a length, de Kock pushes it to covers from his crease.
Fuller outside off, Amla drives it to wide mid off who is a touch slow and a single is stolen.
Angles it on a length on off, Amla defends it watchfully.
Outside off, wide enough for Amla to be left alone.
Slants it into the batsman, Amla clips it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Sprays it wide outside off, Amla cannot reach it. Wide signaled.
Lands it outside off, de Kock comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Third slip goes out.
FOUR! Poor line from Willey! Slants it on the pads, Willey clips it through mid-wicket for a sublime boundary. You can't bowl on the pads to batsmen today.
Full and coming into the batsman, Amla clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side, Amla looks to clip it through but misses. There is a leg gully in place but not sure if that is the best way to get rid of Amla, at least with the new ball.
Edged! Good length on off, de Kock looks to work it through the leg side but gets it off the outside edge to third man for a single.
A tad short around off, de Kock punches it to covers from his crease.

FOUR! Slants it on the stumps, Amla looks to clip it. The ball goes down to the fine leg fence. The umpire signals it runs so there was bat involved. Third boundary for him in that region. England are not bowling well to him.
Back of a length on middle, nudged towards square leg for a single.
On a length outside off, de Kock times his push towards mid off.
Back of a length outside off, Amla punches it on the up towards extra cover for a single.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side, Amla fails to clip it through.
Around off, on a good length, Amla is happy to let it be.
Slants it on the pads, de Kock misses his clip. The ball rolls off his pads towards mid-wicket for a single. Leg Bye signaled.
Fuller on off, Amla drives it off the inner half towards the leg side.
Slants it on a fuller length outside off, left alone.
Short outside off, Amla punches it towards point where the fielder makes a good diving stop.
Brings this length ball back from around off, Amla is forced to defend watchfully.
FOUR! Poor line! Slants it on the pads, Amla clips it to the fine leg fence neatly. This is not the line Morgan wants him to bowl.
Good length on off, de Kock turns it towards mid-wicket for a single.
This is wide outside off, left alone by Amla.
Short and wide outside off, Amla throws his bat at it. The keeper collects the ball and appeals along with the slip cordon. England even contemplate the review - tells you how desperate they are.
There is a slight drizzle right now.
Bowls it outside off, Amla defends it watchfully.
Edged! Good length outside off, de Kock throws his bat at it. The ball goes off the outside edge down to third man for a single.
A tad short outside off, de Kock punches it towards point from his crease.
Fuller in length on off, de Kock pushes it towards mid on.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side, de Kock cannot clip it away. Wide signaled.
Jake Ball to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Finally the length he wants to bowl. On a length, just around off, Amla defends it watchfully.
Sprays it wide outside off, Amla lets it go through.
FOUR! Poor line and punished! Slants it on middle and leg, swings down, Amla clips it nicely to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Good start already for the visitors.
Similar ball outside off, Amla leaves it.
Slants it wide outside off, Amla lets it go through watchfully.
FOUR! Top shot! Shorter length outside off, Amla gets on top of it and punches it wide of the point fielder for a boundary. What a way to get off the mark and set the tone for the chase.
Welcome back for the chase. Quinton de Kock and Hashim Amla are out to bat for South Africa. David Willey to bowl with the first new ball. Here we go...
